title: The bank writes to the trustee
description: The family trust is found to be £41,212 overdrawn.

title: The Colonel's medicines change hands
description: The nurse hands everything in the medicine cabinet over for the probate inventory.

title: Foxgloves for the house
description: The gardener cuts foxgloves for the drawing-room vases.

title: The nephew arrives
description: The estranged nephew gets off the bus in the village.

title: Her ladyship in the pantry
description: The widow is seen in the housekeeper's pantry.

title: The reading begins
description: The solicitor begins to read the will in the drawing room.

title: A car is moved off the drive
description: The gardener moves a visitor's car to let a delivery through.

title: Someone goes out to a car
description: A man leaves the drawing room and searches the glovebox of the black Humber.

title: Tea is served
description: The housekeeper brings the tea tray.

title: A cup is poured
description: Gerald's cup is poured at the sideboard and carried to him.

title: Gerald collapses
description: Before the reading is finished, Gerald Ashcombe falls at the tea table.
